meta.title: Agora — Midweek meeting program
meta.description: Type the names and Agora works out the timing and leaves you a print-ready PDF. No account, nothing to install.

hero.title: You type the names. That's it.
hero.subtitle: Agora works out the timing and leaves you a print-ready PDF.

howItWorks.title: Three steps.
howItWorks.step1Body: The workbook is already downloaded, parts and songs included.
howItWorks.step2Body: Type the first letters and pick.
howItWorks.step3Body: Save the PDF or share it.

schedules.title: Stop adding up minutes by hand.
schedules.body: Change one part and every time below shifts on its own.
schedules.circuit: Circuit overseer visiting? Mark it and the program reorders.
schedules.slack: 26 min left over · 8·8·10 to the songs
schedules.sampleMinistry: Apply Yourself to the Field Ministry

preview.title: The preview doesn't look like the PDF. It is the PDF.
preview.point1Body: The column widens on its own.

features.editBody: Type over it and you're done.
features.gapsBody: If a week was left half-done.

privacy.title: Your data, wherever you say.
privacy.soloWarning: The password can't be recovered. If you lose it, whatever's on this device is lost with it. Back up now and then.
privacy.teamNote: Everything in the cloud is encrypted. But a copy of the key stays on the server so you can sign in from another device.

downloads.title: Try it now. The apps are on their way.
downloads.comingSoonBody: Android, iPhone, iPad, Mac and Windows.
